note: Track breath, step 8 (longer breaths out): the "sss-zzz" breathwork set twice as long as its default ("seconds": 6, six rounds), so the test is whether the air stays steady to the end of each sound. Kept apart from the intermediate block of this drill, since a choice can't change a tool's seconds.

exercise.title: Hiss, then buzz, for longer
exercise.why: A hiss is air alone and a buzz is the same air with your voice on it, so holding each for longer shows whether the air stays steady when the voice comes in.

cells.text:
Press Start in the circle below. Hiss on "sss" as the circle shows, then add your voice and buzz on "zzz", then hiss again.
If the buzz runs out of air before the circle moves on, take in a little less and spend it more slowly.
Practice until the air moves at the same speed right to the end of each sound.
